jobs.occupation: Seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Communication Coordinator to strengthen our team.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing cleaning company based in Copenhagen, delivering high-quality cleaning services to private homes, offices, and commercial clients. As our operations expand, we are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Communication Coordinator to strengthen our internal and external communication flow and support our team in delivering excellent service every day.

Role Overview

As our Communication Coordinator, you will be the central link between management, cleaning staff, and clients. You’ll ensure that information flows clearly, tasks are communicated efficiently, and clients receive timely updates. Your work will directly support smoother operations, better customer satisfaction, and a more organized work environment.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Coordinate daily communication between cleaning staff and management

• 
Handle client inquiries, updates, and service-related communication

• 
Manage scheduling changes and communicate updates to staff

• 
Support onboarding communication for new employees

• 
Prepare internal updates, guidelines, and announcements

• 
Assist with documentation, reporting, and administrative tasks

• 
Maintain clear communication channels across the company

• 
Help resolve misunderstandings or operational issues quickly

• 
Contribute to improving communication processes and workflows

Qualifications

• 
Experience in coordination, communication, administration, or customer service

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills

• 
Ability to stay organized and manage multiple tasks at once

• 
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

• 
Positive, solution-oriented mindset

• 
Experience in the cleaning or service industry is a plus

• 
English proficiency required (Danish is plus )

• 
Must be based in Copenhagen or willing to relocate

What We Offer

• 
Competitive salary

• 
A stable full-time position

• 
A friendly, supportive team

• 
Opportunities for professional growth

• 
Flexible working structure

• 
A role where your communication skills make a real impact

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short motivation message to kleanqueenjobs@gmail.com with the subject line “Communication Coordinator – Application”.
We review applications continuously and encourage early applications.

Risskov Teknik og Solar ApS · Risskov, Aarhus · [Full-time] · English-speaking role

Every commercial solar offer starts as a technical calculation. The technical team builds that calculation; you translate it into an offer. Our Technical Director takes it to the client and closes the deal.

RTS designs and installs solar solutions for Danish homes in the range of 1 kW-30 kW and for Danish companies and public organizations, in the 50 kW–1 MW segment.

What you will do

• 
You receive the calculation, price build-up, margin check from the technical team and make a customer offer following our existing systems, tools and templates.

• 
The customer offers are then reviewed and approved by our Technical Director, who then sends them to the clients.

• 
When we participate in tenders, you support our Technical Director to ensure that our responses and compliance along with the checklists for the project are updated and sent.

• 
Under the guidance of our Technical Director, keep customer records, project documentation, offer templates, data sheets and the price library current.

• 
Prepare pipeline summaries for sales meetings and the input for lessons learned on closed projects.

• 
When required, research for materials, prices and regulatory requirements that a client, a project or our Technical Director wants to investigate about.

• 
Support the Technical Director on the day to day: calls, calendar, meeting material, documentation and follow up on supplier deliveries.

What you bring

• 
A structured way of working and thinking.

• 
Precision with numbers and advanced Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• 
Fluent written English. Danish is not required, because client conversations are handled by Danish colleagues.

• 
Comfortable working within processes and new tools and systems.

• 
No solar sizing experience required.

• 
Positive energy and the conviction that a good working place is everyone’s job.

**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

****What if planning could shape the future, not just react to it?

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You will own the Nordic Sales and Operations Planning cycle, lead a distributed planning team and help move the organization from reactive expediting towards confident, forward-looking decisions.

**Your impact

****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Own one Nordic demand and supply plan, bringing tender and contract intelligence into the forecast early enough to influence decisions.

• Lead the full S&OP cycle, from portfolio and demand reviews through supply and management review, with clear monthly decisions and ownership.

• Take accountability for inventory health, availability and the working-capital effect of the plan, while preventing excess and risk stock from rebuilding.

• Lead and develop four planners and one analyst across Denmark, Sweden and Finland, creating one way of working that is resilient across countries and absences.

• Connect sales, category, tender, sourcing, finance, warehouse and transport around the same facts, priorities and actions.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You combine strong planning craft with practical leadership. You are comfortable moving between item-level detail and senior stakeholder decisions, and you know how to challenge constructively when the numbers tell a different story.

**You Are Likely To Bring

**

• 8-12 years in supply chain, including at least five years in demand and supply planning or S&OP.

• Experience owning a full S&OP or IBP cycle and leading a planning team, ideally across more than one country.

• Strong knowledge of inventory, working capital, forecast quality and excess or obsolete stock.

• Hands-on experience with an advanced planning system such as Slim4, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or a comparable platform, plus strong Excel or BI skills.

• Professional English and, preferably, Danish or Swedish.

• A relevant Bachelor or Master degree. APICS, IBF or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

**The environment you will step into

**The scope is genuinely Nordic and the mandate is broad. You will have the space to shape the process while keeping the daily business moving.

You will work closely on standards, tools and the group excess and risk stock process. Your influence will reach well beyond your direct team, so trust, clarity and follow-through will matter as much as technical expertise.

**Ready to build what comes next?

**If you want to lead a cross-border team, create one Nordic planning approach and turn better demand and supply decisions into stronger service and healthier inventory, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark or Kungsbacka Sweden. Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe is part of the role.

**Apply and help shape one Nordic view of demand and supply

**Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to this next chapter of Nordic planning.

**About Mediq

**Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services, and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics, and home care, we ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq we offer jobs that change lives, join us.

The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

• C# and .NET, TypeScript, React

• AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

• Event driven services and large scale data pipelines

• GitHub Actions for CI and CD

• Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

What we will be doing

• Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.

• Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.

• Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.

• Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.

• Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.

• Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.

• Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.

• Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.

• Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.

• 10 or more years of professional software development experience.

• 5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.

• A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.

• You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.

• Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.

• Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.

• Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

• Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it.

What we will love about you

• Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.

• Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

• Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America.

• You take pride in the work of the team and lead by example.

• You are comfortable replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

What you'll love about usWe’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.

Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

Siteimprove is a global corporation that has developed data practices to ensure your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/.

Do you want to work in a company that develops systems to help keep people and society safe?

We are looking for an experienced Bid Manager to lead and manage the full bid lifecycle for complex defense and security solutions, ensuring the submission of high-quality, compliant, and competitive proposals that align with Saab's strategic objectives.

Your Role

As a Bid Manager, you will own the end-to-end bid lifecycle, serving as the strategic lead from initial qualification through to contract award. You will be responsible for orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact proposals that align our technical capabilities with our customers' most critical needs.

• Strategic Leadership: Formulate and execute winning bid strategies in close collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Legal, and Finance.

• Analysis & Compliance: Conduct deep-dive analyses of RFPs and ITTs to ensure all customer requirements are fully understood and meticulously met.

• Proposal Development: Craft compelling, technically accurate proposals that maintain high standards of clarity, consistency, and professionalism.

• Project Governance: Manage bid budgets and timelines, proactively mitigating risks to ensure on-time, high-quality submissions.

• Stakeholder Coordination: Facilitate internal and external review cycles, integrating diverse feedback into a cohesive final document.

• Commercial Negotiation: Provide expert input on proposal content and commercial terms during customer negotiations.

• Market Intelligence: Leverage trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to sharpen our competitive edge.

• Process Innovation: Drive the continuous improvement of our bid management tools and internal methodologies.

Your Profile

We are seeking a strategic professional who combines technical acumen with commercial savvy. You have a proven track record of securing high-value contracts within complex technology sectors and the leadership skills to guide multidisciplinary teams under pressure.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• Experience: 3-5 years of bid, proposal, or project management experience within the defense, aerospace, or complex technology sectors.

• Proven Success: A demonstrated history of leading and winning complex, high-value bids.

• Regulatory Knowledge: A strong grasp of government procurement processes and contractual frameworks.

• Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.

• Leadership: Strong ability to motivate, coordinate, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Operational Excellence: Superior organizational skills and an acute attention to detail.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Suite and dedicated bid management software.

• Mobility: Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and are in a transition phase to develop more product focused deliveries. This gives you a great opportunity to take part in shaping the future system designs and deliveries to a demanding customer segment. You can expect:

• A key leadership role in a technically advanced defense environment.

• The opportunity to influence the safety and supportability of products and systems across their complete lifecycle.

• A skilled and committed multidisciplinary team.

• Professional development and opportunities to grow within the organization.

• Focus on our teams, good collaboration and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.

Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

Location: Denmark

**About Sedna

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About The Role

**Sedna is the platform at the centre of how the shipping industry works - 10 million emails processed daily for 950+ shipping and trading customers, and a product suite that now spans email intelligence, vessel management and a growing family of AI agent products. As an Account Executive, you'll be one of the people responsible for bringing that platform to new customers across the maritime and shipping world.

This is a strategic, high-ownership sales role. You'll run the full sales cycle - from first conversation through to close - introducing prospects to the value Sedna brings across operational control, collaboration and data-driven decision-making. From new business acquisition to expansion within existing accounts, you'll drive the process with the autonomy and accountability of a founder. We're looking for someone who thrives on impact, builds trust through expertise, and consistently exceeds targets.

Working in a fast-growth company means that no day is ever the same! But here are the main responsibilities and tasks you'll undertake while working for us:

Industry and product knowledge

• Develop deep expertise across Sedna's platform, understanding how it supports email intelligence, end-to-end voyage planning, operational control and financial performance.

• Build credibility in the owner, operator and charterer segments by tailoring your approach to their commercial and operational models.

• Stay up to date with market trends and the competitive landscape to position Sedna effectively.

• Use the Sedna platform regularly to gain hands-on understanding of its features, integrations and impact on customers' businesses.

• Leverage existing customer stories and results to showcase Sedna's real-world value to prospects.

Lead generation

• Build and qualify a pipeline of high-potential accounts across global shipping and maritime operators.

• Research and prioritise key segments (e.g. dry bulk, tankers, offshore) based on size, tech stack and operational complexity.

• Develop and execute personalised outreach campaigns to engage key decision-makers at the right time.

• Attend and represent Sedna at relevant international maritime events to increase visibility and network with potential buyers.

• Partner with RevOps and Marketing to ensure pipeline-building activities align with company priorities and revenue goals.

Building relationships with prospects and closing deals

• Run discovery conversations that surface operational inefficiencies and connect them to Sedna's platform capabilities.

• Deliver tailored demos that demonstrate how Sedna solves challenges across planning, execution, finance and collaboration.

• Scope how Sedna would be implemented within the prospect's organisation - including integration with systems, key workflows and expected outcomes.

• Lead any technical validation or trial processes, ensuring alignment between stakeholders and measurable success criteria.

• Negotiate and close deals with commercial rigour and customer-centricity, aligned to targets and timeline expectations.

• Ensure a smooth handover to onboarding and success teams so new customers experience immediate value.

Account penetration

• Create detailed account plans that map stakeholders, current systems and areas of opportunity for Sedna.

• Identify expansion opportunities through continued discovery and regular engagement with operational and strategic leaders.

• Develop multi-threaded relationships across functions - ensuring Sedna is positioned as a mission-critical platform, not a point solution.

• Coordinate with pre-sales, customer success and product teams to craft joint plans that drive long-term value and platform growth.

• Proactively track and pursue cross-sell opportunities across Sedna's product suite where aligned to customer goals.

Building relationships with your existing customers and closing deals

• Prioritise your customer book based on strategic value, expansion potential and product fit.

• Keep aligned with evolving customer goals and demonstrate how Sedna's roadmap and features can continue delivering business impact.

• Run product workshops and strategic reviews to surface opportunities for additional modules, integrations or licenses.

• Lead commercial conversations around renewals and expansions - ensuring favourable outcomes for both customer and Sedna.

• Maintain frequent contact with decision-makers, offering strategic guidance and facilitating cross-functional collaboration to ensure continued success.

• Work closely with GTM, product and success teams to align efforts around shared goals and ensure consistency across the customer experience.

Continuous improvement

• Contributing and maintaining data for effective forecasting.

• Contributing to the Product, Marketing, Success and other teams to help Sedna be a better company and platform, and in turn, make a bigger impact on our customers.

• Reflecting on successes and failures, and making improvements to your ways of working as a result.

**About You

**At Sedna, we believe it's your skills and attributes that ultimately make you successful in a role. Here's what we're looking for:

Either:

Shipping experience - hands-on commercial experience within the shipping or maritime industry (e.g. operations, chartering, broking, ship management) matters to us.

Or:

Sales experience - a minimum of 3-5 years' sales B2B sales experience, ideally in a solution-led, consultative environment where you've owned the full cycle from discovery to close.

• Self motivated - you are motivated to achieve in this role because of your enthusiasm - you relish pressure from others but don't need it to succeed.

• Concise communicator - you can articulate a message in a calm, clear, focused way. You hold your audience's attention, and they retain what you tell them. Equally, you actively listen and interpret what your audience tells you.

• Emotionally intelligent - you understand, use and control your emotions in positive ways, to relieve stress, empathise with others, overcome challenges, and diffuse conflict.

• Technical aptitude - you keep abreast with modern technologies and have the ability to learn and master them quickly.

• Coachability - you have the ability to adapt and improve as required.

**Our Values

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Are you passionate about Linux and business-critical application operations? If so, you have the opportunity to play a key role in operating some of Denmark’s most business- and society-critical solutions. We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join Netcompany Operations, with solid Linux expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers and public cloud environments.

Our customer portfolio is highly diverse, ranging from small private companies to large-scale public sector projects. We approach operations with a clear vision: to make a meaningful difference to our customers’ businesses, and we expect you to share that ambition.

You will become part of a team focused on the optimization and operation of large, complex Enterprise Linux environments. From day one, you will be given significant responsibility and influence, playing a central role in designing, implementing, and optimizing both current and future solutions while maintaining direct contact with our customers.

As an experienced Operations Engineer, your responsibilites will typically include:

• Building and maintaining Linux-based environments and applications.

• Ensuring quality, optimization, and automation across environments and applications.

• Participating in ongoing operations projects, including major implementation and transition initiatives.

• Prioritizing and following up on customer requests within your area of responsibility.

About you

You are structured, detail-oriented, and highly accountable. You take full ownership of your work, have a strong service mindset, and understand the importance of supporting business objectives in a positive and constructive manner. In short, you are motivated by making a real impact.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to:

• Hold a degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field (bachelor’s, master’s, or equivalent).

• Have several years of experience from a a similar role.

• Are motivated by delivering optimal business- and mission-critical solutions.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We encourage you to apply even if your educational background differs from the above, provided you have relevant qualifications and/or professional experience from a similar position.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for both newly graduated candidates with a relevant master’s degree – or equivalent experience – who want to work as IT Consultants at the intersection of technology, business, and people. Do you want to help develop some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions, where software development, project management, and close client collaboration are central parts of everyday work?

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Consultant, you help translate client needs into the right technical solution. We choose the technologies that best fit each project and client. As a result, you should enjoy working across a variety of technologies and domains, while continuously expanding your knowledge and expertise.

A large part of our projects is based on web technologies such as Angular or React, and Java or C# on either a Java or .NET platform. In addition, we work with a wide range of standard platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and others.

As an IT Consultant, you contribute to all parts of system development with a focus on technical tasks. Your tasks will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilites will typically include:

• Setting up and developing frameworks and integrations.

• Implementing features in user interfaces.

• Configuring and developing extensions for standard platforms.

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs.

• Developing tools and scripts for migrating large volumes of data.

You will join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise. What we all have in common is a technical mindset and shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you will help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience – most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong technical skills in object-oriented programming.

• Have a solid understanding of software development and are motivated to further develop your skills.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Vertical Market Development Lead - HVAC/R, Europe
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As Vertical Market Development Lead for HVAC & Refrigeration in Europe, you will play a key role in shaping and accelerating Danfoss' growth within one of our most important market segments.

You will develop and drive the regional vertical strategy, helping customers address challenges related to energy efficiency, sustainability, and system performance. By combining deep market understanding with strong commercial leadership, you will identify growth opportunities, strengthen our market position, and support the successful execution of business priorities across Europe.

You'll join a global team driving growth and market development within HVAC & Refrigeration. Working closely with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders across regions, you'll help shape strategic initiatives and accelerate business growth. The role can be based at any Danfoss Drives location in Europe and requires travel of up to 50% of the time.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead the development and execution of the HVAC & Refrigeration vertical strategy across Europe to drive growth, market penetration, and customer engagement.

• Develop regional go-to-market approaches by leveraging customer insights, market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive intelligence.

• Identify and assess market opportunities, support business case development, and provide recommendations on growth priorities and investment decisions.

• Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, system integrators, partners, and industry stakeholders to expand Danfoss' presence and create new business opportunities.

• Enable commercial success by providing market intelligence, sales guidance, training, and strategic support while helping secure a strong pipeline, portfolio mix, and pricing position.

As a recognized vertical expert, you will promote best practice sharing across the organization, identify emerging market trends, and drive collaboration across global and regional teams to maximize customer value and business impact.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in business development, sales, marketing, or vertical development within Drives (VFDs), HVAC, Refrigeration, or a related industry.

• Strong understanding of HVAC & Refrigeration markets, customers, applications, and value chains.

• Proven ability to develop and execute growth strategies, go-to-market plans, and commercial initiatives.

• Skilled at leading through influence, building alignment across a matrix organization, and engaging stakeholders with credibility.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field; experience with drives, automation, or energy-efficient technologies is an advantage.

You are a strategic and customer-focused professional who enjoys turning market insights into action, building strong partnerships, and driving growth across a complex international organization.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

This role offers the opportunity to shape Danfoss' growth agenda within HVAC & Refrigeration, influence strategic decisions at both regional and global levels, and collaborate with industry-leading customers and partners across Europe.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**At Danfoss, we believe that diverse perspectives foster innovation and help us create better solutions for our customers and communities.

If you're excited about driving growth, shaping market strategy, and influencing the future of HVAC & Refrigeration across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply and show us how your skills, experience, and perspective can contribute to our success.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive Business-Led Innovation: Identify and assess high-potential business challenges and market opportunities, building business cases and revenue models.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

• Act as the Core Connector: Bridge leadership, business stakeholders, R&D, domain experts, and engineering teams to align goals and direction.

• Accelerate Delivery: Drive progress from exploration and validation to implementation, delivering measurable results in weeks to months.

• Frame & Structure Concepts: Turn complex ideas into clear opportunities, hypotheses, trade-offs, and actionable next steps.

• Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with leadership on executive communication, representing the team with confidence and transparency.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong Commercial Mindset: Assess market potential, customer value, and ROI while balancing commercial and technical perspectives.

• Product & Portfolio Experience: Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner, or Portfolio Manager leading digital solutions from discovery to delivery.

• Domain & Digital Familiarity: Experience or strong interest in digital services, IoT, cloud solutions, connected products, and industrial applications.

• Exceptional Structuring Skills: Bring clarity, focus, and direction to complex and ambiguous challenges.

• Proactive Communicator: Excel at stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and team representation.

• Outcome-Driven Execution: Deliver measurable business results by driving progress, prioritizing effectively, and managing trade-offs.

• Education & Language: Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar, with fluent professional English.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**About Us

**Do you wish to join the House of Dreams?

In this House, you will continue to perpetuate the dream of our creator: that of a more beautiful and happier world.

You will also consolidate our vision: to become the most desirable House in the world of beauty, an absolute reference of French luxury, a symbol of joy and hope.

This Vision Is Carried By Our Six Values That You Will Embody Daily As Designers Of Dreams - Values That Engage And Define Us

_Create Passionately

__Craft together with joy

__Excel for ultimate luxury

__Lead with audacity

__Cultivate Triumphant inclusivity

__Commit and act to re-enchant the world.

__**Design your dreams with Dior.

**_**Your Impact

**As Training Manager, you have the pivotal mission to embody and champion the exquisite heritage and brand values of DIOR while driving the development of human capital (Beauty Consultants, Promoters, Generic Staff) and retail excellence across PCD's doors within a dynamic travel retail environment.

Fostering a culture of continuous learning and outstanding client experience, you inspire and equip retail teams with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to deliver on both collective and individual performance objectives. A true learning strategist, you design and deploy multi-faceted training programs and action plans that empower teams to over-achieve their POS objectives while nurturing strong performers and future people developers.

You play an essential role as the key link between the field (70% of your time) and HQ stakeholders, translating business priorities into impactful learning solutions across the following three key areas: Beauty Consultants coaching, In-class and digital trainings and Seminars.

Position

**BEAUTY CONSULTANTS COACHING

**

• Design and deploy a structured and progressive training curriculum covering product knowledge, brand heritage, makeup artistry, skincare expertise and advanced selling techniques, together with the Retail Manager in your region

• Track and measure knowledge acquisition through regular quizzes, certifications and practical assessments,

• Conduct individual appraisals at regular intervals, delivering clear, constructive and motivating feedback to each Beauty Consultant

• Build and monitor personalized Individual Development Plans for each Beauty Consultant, setting SMART objectives and milestones to track progress over time

• Oversee BC uniform and grooming allocation to ensure every BC is impeccably equipped at all times

**IN CLASS AND DIGITAL TRAININGS

**

• Conduct tailor-made and context specific trainings based on the knowledge and analysis of each point of sale (airport typology, passenger profile, product assortment)

• Lead the operational preparation of the training sessions by defining the timing, the place, the attendees and all logistics aspects aligned with the Retail Manager and key commercial milestones (product launches, peak travel periods, trade animation)

• Measure the efficiency and business impact of every training through a clear set of KPIs and using sell out data

• Develop and upskill promoters and generic staff populations in key strategic airports by designing targeted and time-efficient training programs

**SEMINARS

**

• At Travel Retail Europe level: support the organization, coordination and animation of the Annual Convention with all Dior Beauty Consultants in collaboration with the Travel Retail Training Department

• At your perimeter level: organize with the Retail Manager and animate the Local Seminars (Sales Cycle) 3 times a year in physical or/and digital

• Maintain a rigorous budget tracking process to ensure cost efficiency and return on investment aligned with business priorities

**REPORTING TO

**

• Area Manager (based in Paris)

• The responsibilities outlined in this job description are subject to change based on the company's needs and ongoing projects

Profile

Ideally, you would have 3 years of experience in Retail Training, Coaching and Retail Management

**Create Passionately

**Soft skills that align with our values:

• Creative & Innovative

**Lead With Audacity

**

• Exemplary Leadership & People Management Capacity

• Stakeholder Management Capacity

**Craft Together With Joy

**

• Teamwork & Collaboration

**Cultivate Triumphant Inclusivity

**

• Learning Agility

**Excel For Ultimate Luxury

**

• Attention to detail

**Other Skills

**

• Master Diplloma from an International Business school

• Knowledge of perfumes and cosmetics preferable.

• Curiosity about travel retail business

• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in additional languages relevant to the travel retail location is a significant advantage

• Flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as dictated by the demands of a dynamic travel retail environment

• It is expected to be on the field and traveling at a minimum of 4 days per week.

Additional information

Inclusivity is not just a noble principle; it is the very heart of our excellence. In a world where our clients, talents, and ideas increasingly come from diverse backgrounds, our diversity is our strength.

At Parfums Christian Dior, this means being a House where everyone feels respected, welcomed, and valued, regardless of their uniqueness. Because we know well: a House that reflects this diversity is a sustainable, vibrant House, rooted in both dreams and reality. Inclusivity cannot be decreed; it is practiced daily.

Recruitment steps

Skills development opportunities

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you motivated by working in a growing company which develops cutting edge products in the laser industry? Hamamatsu Photonics is an exciting, inspiring place to work where we encourage both personal and career development. To support our plans, we are now expanding our team as we are looking for Senior Electronics Engineers.

**About Us

**Hamamatsu Photonics is a dynamic, international high-tech company and a leader in the development, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance lasers and photonic crystal fibers. We employ some of the best and most creative people in our industry and together we have established one of the fastest growing and most innovative photonics companies in the world.

We embrace a culture in which a healthy work-life balance is encouraged; and we promote a positive, supportive working environment. To support our growth plans, we are investing in our facilities and growing our talented teams. We provide a great place to work with good people and exciting, industry-leading products.

**THE ROLE

**You will be working with a mix of custom-made technologies and ground research. You will design, develop and implement electronic systems and laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will closely collaborate with experts in your own and other fields to meet the demanding requirements. The products you develop are typically low volume but high margin, reflecting the complexity and effort put into each system. You are prepared to learn to interpret and scope fuzzy customer requirements.

• Be responsible for Electronics development for laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Work closely with experts from other areas like optics and mechanics on system design.

• Take ownership of project work packages within product development projects; work with project managers to ensure delivery of solutions within the planned deadlines and budgets.

• Interact with project and product stakeholders and communicate information clearly across the R&D organization.

• Form new and innovative design concepts and take ownership of electronics system designs.

• Create reference designs for other electronics designers in our organization.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, product improvement activities.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to industry standards

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

**

• Experience from senior roles in developing advanced PCBs for complex systems spanning the complete product life cycle.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills engaging with management and other engineering disciplines.

• Proven track record of successful PCB productization.

• Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following areas: analog design, power supplies, control loops, digital interfaces or low noise designs.

• Detailed knowledge of state of the art electronic and software technologies.

• Experience of working with external partners.

• A scientific mindset, out of the box thinker but still with a practical approach.

• Master’s degree in electronics or similar.

• English – both oral and written

**WE OFFER

**Professional challenges in a highly dynamic and growing business environment with enormous potential for further growth. An opportunity to become part of a successful, enthusiastic, development team in an informal workplace. Competitive employment terms and benefits, good work-life balance, and influence on own tasks. Experienced and skilled colleagues with highly diverse backgrounds in an international organization.

**APPLY TODAY

**We plan to invite candidates for interviews as soon as possible. If you think you have what it takes, please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in one document) to us and we will be in contact soon.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Based at our welcoming Roskilde office, you will join the Workplace department, which develops and maintains BEC’s cloud-based Microsoft platform, including SharePoint and Microsoft 365 administration services, for BEC and our 25 Danish banking customers.

As a Senior Microsoft 365 Platform/System Engineer, you will join a team of dedicated professionals focused on developing SharePoint and Microsoft 365 within our Modern Workplace services.

You will be part of a cross-country, agile Microsoft 365 team comprising 12 dedicated professionals.

At BEC, we value regular in-office collaboration while offering flexibility to work remotely for up to eight days per month. You will report to Anne-Mette Bluhme.

**Your primary tasks and responsibilities will include:

**

• Developing and managing SharePoint Online Services

• Administering and maintaining the Microsoft 365 suite, including Copilot, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams and OneDrive for Business

• Ensuring the availability, performance, and security of these services

• Implementing and managing security controls for Microsoft 365 environments, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

• Participation in development projects of new services

**To succeed in this role, you should have:

**

• Solid experience in SharePoint development and maintenance

• Solid experience administering Microsoft 365 services

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, and Copilot

• Knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Microsoft Purview

**It would also be an advantage to have:

**

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Development Manager Anne-Mette Bluhme at abz@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Summary

As an Entry-level Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Copenhagen, you will join a diverse project team to address complex client challenges. Responsibilities include conducting research, analysing data, preparing deliverables such as presentations and workshops, and supporting client decision-making. The role offers flexibility to specialise early, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to work across industries. Applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s is also accepted), fluency in Danish or another Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish), and English. The position values initiative, creativity, and strong analytical skills. Hybrid working and travel within the home market are part of the role. No specific industry experience or academic majors are required.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

• As a member of your project team you’ll work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients worldwide to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

• You’ll help teams understand client challenges by conducting research, gathering data, running surveys and interviews, and turning information into clear insights.

• You’ll analyze problems, identify patterns, test hypotheses, and help structure recommendations that support client decision-making.

• You’ll contribute to client-ready deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• You’ll build core consulting skills from the start, including how to structure your work, communicate clearly, contribute to team problem-solving, and manage your priorities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

• From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work.

• Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.

• As you grow, you’ll have opportunities to build confidence, take on more responsibility, and develop the skills to unlock the potential of others.

Learn and grow without limits

• Learn on the job and through formal training, developing core skills in communication, presentation, analytics, problem-solving, and client management.

• Each project will give you new opportunities to learn from specialists, broaden your perspective, and build momentum in your career.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

Who can apply?

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website. If you're having technical issues submitting your application or any questions, please reach out to recruiting.nordics@oliverwyman.com

Do you want to shape how life-changing medicines reach patients around the world? As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will lead a highly specialised team responsible for ensuring global regulatory submissions are delivered with the highest levels of quality, compliance and operational excellence.

Position to be based in Søborg, Denmark.

This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, strategic influence and regulatory expertise in a role that directly supports Novo Nordisk's mission of defeating serious chronic diseases.

**Your New Role

**As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will provide leadership for a team responsible for global publishing activities and archiving. You will act as a key subject matter expert for electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) publishing, while helping to shape the future direction of the function through continuous improvement, operational excellence and strategic collaboration.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing a high-performing team, creating clarity of direction, enabling growth and ensuring effective prioritisation of activities.

• Driving business performance through clear objectives, efficient resource utilisation and successful delivery of critical publishing milestones.

• Ensuring quality, compliance and environmental management standards are maintained through a robust local Quality Management System.

• Building strong partnerships across Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Reporting, R&D, Quality Assurance, DD&IT and senior leadership, while engaging with external authorities and industry stakeholders.

• Contributing to strategic decision-making and representing Novo Nordisk in external industry forums that help influence the future of regulatory operations and submission standards.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the successful delivery of regulatory submissions worldwide, helping ensure that innovative medicines can reach the patients who need them.

**Your New Department.

**In Research & Development, you'll be part of a unit that explores bold scientific ideas and advances them into clinical testing. We combine curiosity, AI tools and human data to develop transformative therapies. Through collaboration and operational excellence, we shape and deliver an innovative pipeline to meet future patient needs.

Within R&D, the Publishing & Archive department is part of Regulatory, Quality & Clinical Reporting Operations (RQ&C Ops). The team plays a critical role in ensuring that regulatory submissions are compliant, accurately structured and delivered across major global health authority regions, including Europe, the United States, Japan and China.

In addition, the department oversees the archiving of regulatory and Trial Master File documentation in accordance with international regulatory requirements. As Associate Director, you will lead a team whose work directly contributes to bringing new medicines to patients around the world.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong regulatory knowledge with the ability to inspire and develop people. You thrive in a complex stakeholder environment and enjoy balancing strategic priorities with operational execution.

**To Succeed In This Role, You Will Ideally Have

**

• A Master's degree and significant experience within regulatory operations, publishing, archiving or related pharmaceutical discipline, including leadership experience.

• Deep understanding of drug development processes, GxP requirements, and relevant global regulatory guidelines.

• Strong expertise in eCTD publishing and regulatory submission requirements across major health authorities such as EMA, FDA and PMDA.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

• A collaborative and resilient leadership style, with a passion for developing people, driving continuous improvement and delivering results with integrity.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity, and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
